summary: A user sent ETH to egonswap.io after it was promoted in a Telegram trading channel and later was told to deposit 2500 dollars to verify the account before withdrawal. The displayed account balance was fake and the additional payment demand was used to extract more funds.
user_mistake: sent ETH to a platform promoted in a Telegram trading channel
prevention: Refuse to deposit additional funds when a platform demands payment to unlock withdrawals / Research domain age and independent reviews before sending crypto
